import json
from pathlib import Path
root=Path('reports/GEDE01')
for addr in ('801D8050','801D8268'):
    for mode in ('canonical','reloc-strict'):
        p=root/f'objdiff-game_fn_{addr}-session-1821-remediation-1-{mode}.json'
        d=json.loads(p.read_text())
        ls=next(s for s in d['left']['symbols'] if s['name']==f'fn_{addr}')
        rs=next(s for s in d['right']['symbols'] if s['name']==f'fn_{addr}')
        lr=sum('relocation' in row.get('instruction',{}) for row in ls['instructions'])
        rr=sum('relocation' in row.get('instruction',{}) for row in rs['instructions'])
        diffs=sum(row.get('diff_kind') is not None for row in ls['instructions'])
        print(f'fn_{addr} {mode} left_bytes={ls["size"]} right_bytes={rs["size"]} left_instructions={len(ls["instructions"])} right_instructions={len(rs["instructions"])} match_percent={ls["match_percent"]} left_relocations={lr} right_relocations={rr} differing_rows={diffs}')
PY

range_measurement.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
import json
addresses=('801D8050','801D8268')
project=json.load(open('objdiff.json'))
units={unit['name']:unit for unit in project['units']}
matched=0
nonmatching=0
for address in addresses:
    report=json.load(open(f'reports/GEDE01/objdiff-game_fn_{address}-session-1821-remediation-1-reloc-strict.json'))
    symbol=next(symbol for symbol in report['left']['symbols'] if symbol['name']==f'fn_{address}')
    if units[f'main/game/game_fn_{address}']['metadata']['complete']:
        matched += int(symbol['size'])
    else:
        nonmatching += int(symbol['size'])
print(f'matched_bytes={matched} nonmatching_bytes={nonmatching}')
PY
